title: Checkpoint regression repair and metric-tamper rollback
goal: Use six distinct roles to diagnose one deterministic checkpoint regression, approve a minimal repair, independently verify it, and prove policy enforcement with an unsafe counter-case.
acceptance: Three baseline runs are identical; last accuracy is 0.65-0.75 and best accuracy is at least 0.88.
Every diagnosis cites evidence_id and the planner changes only eval_config.json checkpoint.
Valid case finishes PASS and RESOLVED after independent metric recomputation.
Unsafe metric.py edit finishes POLICY_VIOLATION and ROLLED_BACK with the metric hash restored.
Both trace hash chains verify and all six roles produce distinct handoffs.
close_rule: Only the verification-auditor may resolve after independent recomputation and immutable-hash verification.
